name: pulseai
description: PulseAI - AI Employee Health & Wellness Platform

scripts.build:packages: node init && npm run build -w @pulseai/config && npm run build -w @pulseai/types && npm run build -w @pulseai/utils
scripts.build: node init && prisma generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @pulseai/api && npm run build -w @pulseai/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pulseai/api -- --runInBand && npm run test -w @pulseai/utils -- --runInBand
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @pulseai/api && npm run lint -w @pulseai/web
